finding: Installed Ghidra word DIVU semantics do not assign the overflow flag VF and always overwrite the result register with packed remainder/low quotient. Original BIWN helper branches on BVS after DIVU.
consequence: Existing automatic C for d1e0/d1ec is not a faithful division reconstruction; automatic function boundaries split one helper across two entries. The reviewed portable C and isolated CPU tests are separate evidence.
scope: Specific installed Sleigh implementation and this use of DIVU/BVS, not a claim that all Ghidra68000 output is wrong.
manual_basis: For word division, quotient overflow sets V and leaves operands unchanged; successful division clears V.
